limits.canvas: The native terminal canvas inherits live terminal colors. export.* is the official HTML export palette, not proof of terminal canvas colors.
limits.assistant: Native assistant Markdown has no filled message background; do not infer an assistant bubble from userMessageBg.
limits.geometry: Native padding is terminal cells/rows. DSH pixels, sidebar, floating composer, file preview and tool card geometry remain host adaptations.
limits.selection: Pi defaults to dynamic system theme, while these extracted palettes are explicit fixed dark/light choices.
limits.approval: These candidate mappings do not register, activate or take theme ownership from OMD. Shared arbitration is outside this source asset.
